description: This file contains utility functions for handling filesystem paths, including path splitting, joining, inserting parts, and filtering hidden files, used within the 'filesys' package of the Kubernetes kustomize project.

methods.name: RootedPath
methods.description: Returns a rooted path, e.g., '/foo/bar', by joining path elements with a leading separator.

methods.name: StripTrailingSeps
methods.description: Removes trailing filepath separators from the input string.

methods.name: StripLeadingSeps
methods.description: Removes leading filepath separators from the input string.

methods.name: PathSplit
methods.description: Converts a file path string into a slice of path components, preserving leading slash for absolute paths.

methods.name: PathJoin
methods.description: Joins a slice of path components into a single path string, adding a leading slash if the first component is empty.

methods.name: InsertPathPart
methods.description: Inserts a path component at a specified position in a given path, handling absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: IsHiddenFilePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path refers to a hidden file or folder (starts with a dot).

methods.name: RemoveHiddenFiles
methods.description: Filters out paths that refer to hidden files or folders from a list of paths.
